title: helianthemum variabile var. hispidum

The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe wounds, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
